data: Existing train600 five frozen E19 outer folds, 480 history / 120 evaluation each
input_features: Original fold-local MiniLM/PCA16/StandardScaler with penalized intercept, 17x20 linear head

conditions.B: All 480 training row weights equal 1, reused frozen model
conditions.C: Zero on empirical all-action-tied rows and 1 elsewhere, reused frozen model

matching.groups: Task and actual BBH subtask labels used only to construct matching strata
matching.within_group: Split history rows into two bins at that group's median nonconstant input-feature L2 norm. Norm<=median is the lower bin.
matching.counts: Within every stratum choose exactly as many zero weights as the number of T rows in that stratum
matching.draw: Ascending SHA256(seed|fold|global canonical hash), no evaluation rewards or decision metrics used
matching.shared: Each frozen mask is reused by both losses. Match exact zero-weight count, total row weight, task/subtask and input-norm-bin counts. Report T overlap and pure strata.
matching.limitation: Four folds have fewer non-T than T rows. A disjoint non-T-only binary deletion of equal count is infeasible. Matched controls therefore remove a mixture of T and non-T rows.

normalization: Keep denominator N=480 and all epigraph rows. No renormalization by retained weight. L2 on every coefficient.
regularization: Exact original E19 per-fold lambda: first four folds 0.003472222222222222, fifth 0.00034722222222222224
reuse: Use original B/C weights and predictions. Recover TSPO B/C legal dual row subgradients with 10 qualified identical-objective solver runs, verify centered scores and objective against originals. ListNet row gradients analytic from frozen weights.
geometry: JT, F0, total parameter and centered-parameter norms, top-score margins, strict switches
Best positive scaling of WB to WC and residual rotation
Decompose evaluation score contrasts into tied-row pressure and non-T response through the same feature map
Check strong-convexity inequalities and report residuals and correlations as descriptive evidence
primary_control_comparisons: C versus the equal average of all three Matched controls
secondary: All individual seed controls and per-fold results reported. No best-seed or best-loss selection.
evaluation: Freeze all new weights, controls and predictions before this run's evaluation-reward reading. GSM8K and BBH 50/50, three seeds remain within question. Preserve per-task/subtask/seed corrections and damages.
statistical_scope: Repeatedly exposed development OOF diagnostic, condition on current fitted models and masks. No confidence intervals, bootstrap, new p-value selection, fresh400 or sealed200 access.
execution: Only existing cached rewards and CPU predictor fitting
